integrity: Analytic Mellin and weighted-translation proof, with explicit phase-uniform disjoint-support resolvent lower bound. Sang's earlier operator representation and general power-supremum formula are credited and are not claimed new. Supplementary finite script is not an infinite proof.
limitations: Only the fixed real nonzero homogeneous exponent and unit kernel coefficient are considered; no exact finite-resolvent norm or sharp second-order correction is claimed. No publication-priority guarantee or independent scientific validation.
title: Gaussian-order resolvent growth of a noncompact homogeneous Hankel quasinilpotent
